login.title: Sign in to the agency portal

register.title: Register your agency
register.lead: The hotel checks your licence before you can book. You can sign in once it approves your agency.
register.name: Agency name
register.received: Thank you. The hotel will check your registration; you can sign in once it is approved.

title.PENDING: Your agency is not approved yet

text.PENDING: The hotel checks your licence first. You can book as soon as your agency is approved.
text.SUSPENDED: The hotel has paused bookings for your agency. Contact the hotel to resume them.
text.REJECTED: The hotel did not approve your agency. Contact the hotel if you think this is a mistake.

bookings.title: Bookings
bookings.releaseText: Booking {no} will be cancelled and its rooms let go.
bookings.askHotel: To cancel or change a confirmed booking, contact the hotel.

book.title: New booking
book.quoteHelp: A quote fits exactly its hotel, dates and pilgrims.
book.quota: Your agency can still hold {count} pilgrims on these nights.
book.holdNote: The rooms are held for a short time: confirm the booking before the hold ends.

scans.title: Passport photos
scans.help: Add photos of the passport pages: each is read, then you check it and save it to a place.
scans.failed: This photo could not be read. Enter the details by hand.
scans.noPlace: No place can take these details now: every pilgrim has arrived or left.
scans.reviewHelp: Compare what was read with the photo, correct it, then save it to a place.

additions.title: Add pilgrims
additions.help: Joining pilgrims sleep in your free places first, at the booking's price.

quotes.title: Quotes
quotes.askHelp: For a large group: the hotel answers with a price for exactly this stay.
quotes.sent: Request sent. Agree the price with the hotel on WhatsApp.
